title_zh: 拟定学校与图书馆合作的名额方案

scenario.label_zh: 拟定学校与图书馆合作的名额方案
scenario.goal_zh: 明确合作与接待容量需求，并约定提出每班一次访问的试行方案

context_zh: 学校联络员与公共图书馆工作人员讨论初次合作，当前每周只能接待两个班级。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Lotte
sentences.text: We want to forge a partnership with your school, rather than offer one visit and disappear.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Then we need to formulate a plan the teachers can actually use. How many classes could you host?

sentences.speaker: Lotte
sentences.text: Two a week. Could we use a simple formula: one visit for each class, spread across the term?

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: That would work for our six classes. We could spread them over three weeks to start.

sentences.speaker: Lotte
sentences.text: Let's put that forward as a trial, then ask teachers whether the timing works.

sentences.speaker: Imran
sentences.text: Yes. I'll draft the class list for the proposal, without treating those weeks as confirmed bookings.
